id: 014_风险评估的步骤与风险矩阵
title: 风险评估的步骤与风险矩阵
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/014_风险评估的步骤与风险矩阵.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/014_风险评估的步骤与风险矩阵/src.py

points.K2: 科研常新，风险要主动找
points.K8: 风险不能消除，只能降低
points.K10: 动手前先评估，导师把关
points.S1: 风险分级管控与隐患排查

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张九宫格卡片，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank three-by-three grid card and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲风险评估的步骤与风险矩阵。
overlay: 风险评估的步骤与风险矩阵

shots.scene: 四个台阶：放大镜、天平、向下箭头、急救箱
shots.prompt_en: Four steps going up, each with an icon: a magnifying glass, a balance scale, a downward arrow, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 先评估，再动手。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一份新实验方案，兴奋地走向实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks excitedly toward a lab bench holding a blank new experiment plan.
shots.narration: 阿杰要做一个全新的实验。

shots.scene: 阿杰对小研说：照着论文做就行
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shrugs and points to a blank journal article, speaking to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 他说：照着论文做，不会有事。

shots.scene: 小研摇头，递给他一张空白评估表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and hands him a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 小研说：先评估风险，再动手。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods at the camera.
shots.narration: 风险怎么评估？一步步来。

shots.scene: 四个台阶依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The four steps light up one by one: magnifying glass, balance scale, downward arrow, first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 风险管理，分四步走。

shots.scene: 放大镜照在实验台上，危险图标显现
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over a lab bench reveals hidden hazard icons. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，识别危害。

shots.scene: 天平一端是危害，另一端是指针
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a hazard icon on one pan and a risk dial on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，评估风险。

shots.scene: 向下的箭头，旁边护目镜和通风柜
shots.prompt_en: A downward arrow beside goggles and a fume hood icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，降低风险。

shots.scene: 急救箱、灭火器和洗眼器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a first aid kit, a fire extinguisher and an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步，做好应急准备。

shots.scene: 拍摄现场的摄像机旁也有这四个台阶
shots.prompt_en: A video camera on a tripod in a lab, with the same four step icons floating beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 无论做实验还是拍视频，都按四步来。

shots.section_title: 科研常新，风险要主动找
shots.scene: 工厂流水线，每个岗位重复同样动作，防护早配好
shots.prompt_en: A factory line where each station repeats the same task, with protective guards already fitted. No people.
shots.narration: 工厂岗位天天一样，规程早就定好。
overlay: 科研常新，风险要主动找

shots.section_title: 科研常新，风险要主动找
shots.scene: 实验台上不断出现新装置和新试剂
shots.prompt_en: New apparatus and new reagent bottles keep appearing on a research lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 科研不同：新实验、新装置不断出现。

shots.section_title: 科研常新，风险要主动找
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着放大镜沿实验步骤找
shots.prompt_en: The young male student uses a magnifying glass to check each step on a blank flowchart.
shots.narration: 要主动去想，哪一步要格外小心。

shots.section_title: 科研常新，风险要主动找
shots.scene: 一瓶新材料，旁边空白的规定夹，阿杰仍戴好防护
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of a new material next to an empty rule binder; the young male student still puts on goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 没有专门规定，也不能无视危险。

shots.scene: 一个公式：严重程度乘以可能性等于风险
shots.prompt_en: A simple equation made of icons: a severity bar times a likelihood bar equals a risk bar. No people.
shots.narration: 风险，等于严重程度乘以可能性。

shots.scene: 严重程度：从创可贴到救护车的刻度
shots.prompt_en: A severity scale from a bandage icon to an ambulance icon. No people.
shots.narration: 严重程度，看后果有多重。

shots.scene: 可能性：从很少到经常的刻度
shots.prompt_en: A likelihood scale from a rarely-used calendar to a calendar full of marks. No people.
shots.narration: 可能性，看多常发生、多容易接触。

shots.scene: 带护栏的高平台和没护栏的矮梯并排
shots.prompt_en: Side by side: a tall work platform with guard rails and a short step ladder without rails. No people.
shots.narration: 高平台有护栏，不易掉，掉了后果重。

shots.scene: 矮梯上的小人图标晃动，警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A stick figure pictogram wobbles on the short ladder without rails, next to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 矮梯没护栏，很容易掉。

shots.scene: 两个场景下面各有一个风险指针
shots.prompt_en: Under each scene a risk dial shows a different level. No people.
shots.narration: 风险高低，要看具体条件。

shots.scene: 三乘三的格子，横轴可能性，纵轴严重程度
shots.prompt_en: A three-by-three grid; the horizontal axis shows likelihood and the vertical axis shows severity, with no text. No people.
shots.narration: 风险矩阵，把两者放进一张表。

shots.scene: 格子从左下绿色渐变到右上红色
shots.prompt_en: The grid cells shade from green at the bottom left through yellow to red at the top right. No people.
shots.narration: 越往右上角，风险越高。

shots.scene: 绿格打勾，旁边向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: A green cell with a check mark and a small downward arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 低风险可接受，也看看能否再降。

shots.scene: 黄格旁边护目镜和一位监督的老师
shots.prompt_en: A yellow cell next to goggles and the older man supervising.
shots.narration: 中风险，有措施和监督才能做。

shots.scene: 红格被一个停止手势挡住
shots.prompt_en: A red cell blocked by a stop hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险，降下来之前不能做。

shots.scene: 排序清单：红色立即整改，绿色定期监控
shots.prompt_en: A priority list with a red item marked urgent with a wrench, and green items marked with a calendar for regular checks. No people.
shots.narration: 风险高的立即整改，低的定期监控。

shots.scene: 五个台阶依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Five steps light up one after another, each with a small icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险评估，可以分五步。

shots.scene: 放大镜照危害，再照几个小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass finds a hazard icon and then several stick figure pictograms nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 找出危害，想清谁会受伤、怎么伤。

shots.scene: 高处架子上的箱子，下方站着的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A box on a high shelf above a stick figure pictogram standing below. No people.
shots.narration: 比如高处放东西，掉下来砸到谁？

shots.scene: 天平和一张措施清单
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale next to a blank list of control measures. No people.
shots.narration: 评估风险，定好控制措施。

shots.scene: 阿杰把结果写进空白记录表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes the results into a blank record form.
shots.narration: 把结果记录下来。

shots.scene: 日历和变化的图标：新人、新设备、新流程
shots.prompt_en: A calendar beside three change icons: a new person, a new instrument and a new procedure. No people.
shots.narration: 人、设备、实验变了，或到期，要回顾更新。

shots.scene: 配电箱旁五个电气评估图标
shots.prompt_en: Beside an electrical panel, five small icons: a lightning bolt, a task card, an injury scale, a broken wire, and a plus sign for extra measures. No people.
shots.narration: 用电作业也这样：风险太高就加措施再评。

shots.scene: 老周稳稳地操作，旁边绿色指针
shots.prompt_en: The older man works steadily at a bench, with a green risk dial beside him.
shots.narration: 评估风险，有一定的主观性。

shots.scene: 阿杰做同样的操作手忙脚乱，旁边黄色指针
shots.prompt_en: The young male student does the same task clumsily, with a yellow risk dial beside him.
shots.narration: 老手稳稳当当，新手可能出错。

shots.scene: 几个人围在一起讨论评估表
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student and the young male student discuss a blank assessment form together.
shots.narration: 所以要多人一起评估，按新手考虑。

shots.scene: 天平上一边是实验收获，一边是风险
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a discovery lightbulb on one side and a risk dial on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 所有实验，都有一定的风险。

shots.scene: 教学实验台，指针在绿区
shots.prompt_en: A teaching lab bench with simple equipment, and a risk dial needle in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 教学实验，老师已把风险降得较低。

shots.scene: 一瓶高危试剂旁没有替代品的空位，指针黄区
shots.prompt_en: A hazardous reagent bottle beside an empty slot where a safer substitute would be, and a dial in the yellow zone. No people.
shots.narration: 高危又无替代品时，可能是中等风险。

shots.scene: 科研实验台旁，老周和王老师一起审核
shots.prompt_en: At a research bench, the older man and the safety administrator review a blank form together.
shots.narration: 科研中接受更高风险，要层层把关。

shots.scene: 指针被拨回可接受区，学生安全工作
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns a risk dial back into the acceptable zone while a student works safely in the background.
shots.narration: 降到可接受水平，多数实验能安全做。

shots.section_title: 风险不能消除，只能降低
shots.scene: 指针降低但始终停在零之上
shots.prompt_en: A risk dial needle drops low but never reaches zero. No people.
shots.narration: 风险不可能完全消除。
overlay: 风险不能消除，只能降低

shots.section_title: 风险不能消除，只能降低
shots.scene: 一小格剩余的黄色，旁边急救箱
shots.prompt_en: A small remaining yellow slice on the dial next to a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 剩下的残余风险，靠应急准备兜底。

shots.section_title: 风险不能消除，只能降低
shots.scene: 向下箭头一层层叠加
shots.prompt_en: Several downward arrows stacked one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 但能而且应当，始终降到最低。

shots.scene: 一张资料不全的表格，旁边按危害类别分好的几个盒子
shots.prompt_en: An incomplete blank data table next to several boxes sorted by hazard category icons. No people.
shots.narration: 数据不全，按危害类别配套措施。

shots.scene: 一套高危装置，每个部件旁一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A complex apparatus with a question mark next to each component. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险工艺，逐一分析失效方式。

shots.scene: 蝴蝶结图：中间一个结，左边挡板，右边挡板
shots.prompt_en: A bow-tie diagram: a central knot, barrier blocks on the left side, and barrier blocks on the right side. No people.
shots.narration: 蝴蝶结图：左边防发生，右边减后果。

shots.scene: 王老师和老周一起分析复杂装置
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man analyze the complex apparatus together.
shots.narration: 复杂情况，请专业人员一起评估。

shots.section_title: 动手前先评估，导师把关
shots.scene: 准备好的实验台：方案、防护、应急箱
shots.prompt_en: A well-prepared bench with a blank plan, protective gear and an emergency kit. No people.
shots.narration: 凡事预则立，准备是安全的关键。
overlay: 动手前先评估，导师把关

shots.section_title: 动手前先评估，导师把关
shots.scene: 阿杰站在实验台前停下，想清楚
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pauses at the bench before touching anything, thinking.
shots.narration: 每次动手之前，先想清楚有哪些风险。

shots.section_title: 动手前先评估，导师把关
shots.scene: 评估表上三栏：危害、防护、应急
shots.prompt_en: A blank form with three column icons: a hazard triangle, goggles, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 想清危害、防护措施和应急办法。

shots.section_title: 动手前先评估，导师把关
shots.scene: 老周审核评估表签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews the blank assessment form and signs it.
shots.narration: 导师审核签字，措施到位再开工。

shots.section_title: 动手前先评估，导师把关
shots.scene: 新实验、新设备、改流程三个图标，旁边评估表
shots.prompt_en: Three icons, a new experiment, a new instrument and a changed procedure, each pointing to a blank assessment form. No people.
shots.narration: 新实验、新设备、改流程，都要重新评估。

shots.section_title: 动手前先评估，导师把关
shots.scene: 高风险实验的报批单盖章
shots.prompt_en: A blank approval form for a high-risk experiment receives a stamp.
shots.narration: 高风险实验，按规定报批。

shots.section_title: 风险分级管控与隐患排查
shots.scene: 两道防线：风险分级管控、隐患排查治理
shots.prompt_en: Two shield layers: one with a graded risk chart icon, the other with an inspection checklist and wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险分级管控，加隐患排查治理。
overlay: 风险分级管控与隐患排查

shots.section_title: 风险分级管控与隐患排查
shots.scene: 四种颜色的等级牌
shots.prompt_en: Four colored level cards in red, orange, yellow and blue, with no text. No people.
shots.narration: 风险等级不同，管控的层级也不同。

shots.section_title: 风险分级管控与隐患排查
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层分别管住不同颜色
shots.prompt_en: A three-level chart, university, department and lab, each holding cards of different colors. No people.
shots.narration: 具体分级，以本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 四个台阶
shots.prompt_en: The four steps: magnifying glass, balance scale, downward arrow, first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 识别、评估、降低、准备。

shots.scene: 风险矩阵从绿到红
shots.prompt_en: The three-by-three risk grid shaded from green to red. No people.
shots.narration: 严重程度乘可能性，用矩阵定等级。

shots.scene: 老周签字，阿杰开始实验
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs the form and the young male student starts the experiment wearing goggles.
shots.narration: 风险降到可接受，评估过关再动手。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一张填好的空白评估表挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a completed blank assessment form and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲风险评估实例与书面记录。
